scripts.build:arc: npm run compile:mdx && npm run build && npm run build:arc:assets && npm run build:arc:server && npm run build:arc:deps
scripts.build:arc:server: mkdir -p server && NODE_ENV=production npx esbuild server.ts --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --bundle --minify --tree-shaking=true --outfile=server/index.mjs '--external:@aws-sdk/*' --external:aws-sdk '--external:@react-router/*' --external:react --external:react-dom '--external:./build/*' && rm -rf server/build/server && mkdir -p server/build/server && cp -r build/server/* server/build/server/
scripts.test:deploy:
echo '
🧪 Simulating Lambda Deployment
' && npm run build:arc:server && npm run build:arc:deps && echo '
📊 Size Analysis:' && echo 'Lambda Handler: '$(du -sh server/index.mjs 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo 'Not built') && echo 'SSR Build: '$(du -sh server/build 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo 'Not built') && echo 'Dependencies: '$(du -sh server/node_modules 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo 'Not installed') && echo 'TOTAL: '$(du -sh server 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo 'Not built') && echo '
✅ Images in Lambda: '$(find server -name '*.jpg' -o -name '*.png' -o -name '*.gif' 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | wc -l | tr -d ' ')' (should be 0)' && echo '✅ Ready to deploy!
'
scripts.dev:arc: npm run build:arc && arc sandbox -e testing
